name: Sad powers
description: You're given Q queries of the form ( L , R ) . For each query you have to find the number of such x that L ≤ x ≤ R and there exist integer numbers a > 0 , p > 1 such that x = a p .
input_specification: The first line contains the number of queries Q (1 ≤ Q ≤ 10 5 ) . The next Q lines contains two integers L , R each (1 ≤ L ≤ R ≤ 10 18 ) .
output_specification: Output Q lines — the answers to the queries.
approach_summary: Precompute linear sieve to store minimum prime factor (spf[x]) up to N in O(N). Factorize any number x ≤ N in O(log x) steps.
